name: Date Type 10 Code
definition: Date is specified as a fixed code value.

MEET.name: Blocking Till Meeting Date
MEET.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the meeting date.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: Date is unknown by the sender or has not been established.

NARR.name: Narrative Unblocking Date
NARR.definition: Refer to additional information element for the date until when the securities are blocked.

RDTE.name: Blocking Till Record Date
RDTE.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the record date of the event.

PPYD.name: Blocking Till Premium Payment Date
PPYD.definition: Unblocking will occur on payment date of the premium.
